title: POP Generator Common Page
summary: Official Derivative common page for POP generator operators, covering Bypass, Free Extra GPU Memory, and Delete Input Attributes behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a generated POP card or planner note needs common POP generator controls.
Bypass passes the first input through unchanged when the operator has an input to pass through.
Free Extra GPU Memory releases accumulated memory after output memory has grown and shrunk.
Delete Input Attributes limits output to the attributes specified by the POP, which can isolate attributes into a separate branch.
